sam_product: Customer legal sent an ask: retain raw audit logs 7 years, BYOK, but also require searchable e-discovery. They want a written runway and acceptance criteria for a contract amendment. Can product/security sketch options?
maria_security: Two high-level patterns: (1) Escrowed-exports: monthly encrypted snapshots pushed to customer storage + notarized manifest. (2) Hybrid-index: Redwood stores encrypted blobs but maintains an encrypted metadata index (searchable) while keys are escrowed by a 3rd-party custodian. Each has different control scopes.
dan_legal: Legal needs custody language, third-party escrow terms, evidence format, notarization proof, and who pays for e-discovery/search indexing. Also want a short bullet list we can attach to the SOW.
arya_engineering: Implementation notes: Escrowed-exports is fastest: snapshot worker, manifest signer, delivery receipts. Hybrid-index needs envelope encryption + blind indexes and a custody escrow API to pull KEK during restore. Hybrid adds complexity but satisfies searchability ask.
lee_sre: Ops items: legal_hold must suspend expiry immediately; manifests must be notarized (option to timestamp via third-party TSA or publish merkle root to a public ledger); restore RTO/RPO needs definition; test plan for legal_hold exercises. Also define retention policy IDs so we can route data into the right lifecycle.
chris_sales: Customer prefers hybrid-index because they want fast e-discovery. They accept paying for indexing + escrow fees. They asked for a pilot timeline and pricing bands.
mar ia_security: Unique security proposal: use a cryptographic accumulator (Merkle tree) per-month, store the signed merkle root in an external timestamping service for non-repudiation. For in-system retention we never hold KEK plaintext: KEK lives with custodian; Redwood holds only a wrapped key reference + attestations.
dan_legal: Contract bullets suggested for SOW attachment:
- retention_policy_id: "SOW-EXT-AUDIT-7Y" TTL=7y
- custody_model: "escrowed_export" or "hybrid_index_with_escrow"
- delivery: monthly encrypted snapshot + signed manifest + notarized merkle root (TSA or pub-ledger)
- evidence_format: per-object blob + manifest with SHA256 + merkle proofs for spot-checks
- legal_hold: immediate pause w/ audit trail + ability for customer to trigger emergency export
- termination: 30d verified export window + escrow handoff process
- liability: tamper-proof notarization reduces Redwood liability; e-discovery cost allocation TBD
- pricing: storage + notarization fee + indexing tiers (details in proposal)
arya_engineering: Prototype notes (sample manifest snippet):
```
manifest_id: m-2026-03-01
object_count: 214
sha256_manifest: 7a3b...f12c
merkle_root: cf9e...a33b
signed_by: redwood-signing-key-v2
notarized_via: timestamp.authority.example/receipt/8342
```
lee_sre: Runbook checklist (skeleton):
- API/CLI: `redwood retention hold set --tenant X --policy SOW-EXT-AUDIT-7Y`
- how to trigger on-demand export and verify merkle proofs
- how to request/verify notarization receipts
- restore verification steps and RTO targets (propose RTO=48-72h for pilot)
- oncall escalation for missed exports or notarization failures
eve_custsuccess: I'll coordinate expectations with the customer. They want pilot in Q2 and a demo of search-on-exported-metadata.
chris_sales: Pricing approach: base=escrowed-export (storage+egress+notarization), premium=hybrid-index (adds indexing + escrow service fee), enterprise=in-place with bespoke audit addendum. I'll draft bands.
maria_security: Compliance notes: hybrid-index increases SOC2/ISO scope; escrowed-export keeps most controls in customer's scope. Recommend export-first as default with hybrid-index as paid enterprise add-on.
 dan_legal: Questions we need product/security to answer for the customer call: 1) Will Redwood accept liability if notarized export proves tampering? 2) Can customer initiate legal_hold via API? 3) What is the exact notarization provider and retention of receipts?
sam_product: Action items (owners):
- sam_product + maria_security: finalize acceptance criteria doc (PR to /docs/compliance/retention-exemptions) by Wed EOD
- dan_legal: draft SOW bullets & custody clause by Fri
- arya_engineering: prototype manifest + merkle proof generator + estimate by next Tue
- lee_sre: draft runbook skeleton + RTO/RPO proposals by next Tue
- chris_sales: pricing bands + pilot proposal by Wed
- eve_custsuccess: schedule pilot kickoff meeting with customer for Thu next week
